test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

 A) Exaggerate

 B) Accommodate

 C) Exuberant

 D) Perservere
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Perservere"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Persevere"**, which means to continue in a course of action even in the face of difficulty or with little or no prospect of success. (डटे रहना)

 
 
• **Example:** Despite facing many challenges, she chose to persevere and achieved her goals.
 
 
 
• The word **"Persevere"** (correct spelling) is defined as maintaining effort and determination despite obstacles. (डटे रहना)
 
 
• **Example:** He had to persevere through countless setbacks to finish his project successfully.
 
 
 
• Hence, the incorrect spelling is "Perservere," and the correct spelling is "Persevere."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exaggerate** (अतिशयोक्ति करना): To describe something as larger or greater than it really is.

 
 
• **Example:** He tends to exaggerate his accomplishments during interviews.
 
 
 
• **Accommodate** (समायोजित करना): To provide space or help someone by meeting their needs.
 
 
• **Example:** The hotel staff were able to accommodate our request for an early check-in.
 
 
 
• **Exuberant** (उत्साही): Full of energy, enthusiasm, or joy.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were exuberant during the school picnic.
